checks.name: default_help_lists_v2_commands
checks.detail:
usage: native_engagement.py [-h]
                            {inspect,run,resume,direction,stop,export,status,claim,submit} ...

Operate a versioned v2 research engagement. Explicit v1 inputs and existing v1
roots retain their compatibility driver.

positional arguments:
  {inspect,run,resume,direction,stop,export,status,claim,submit}
    inspect             verify inputs without model or target contact
    run                 initialize and run the signed v2 engagement
    status              read state or one authenticated worker update page
    claim               claim ready work through the worker endpoint
    submit              submit a typed worker request

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
